entities.name: DCN-ID
entities.description: An information element that the network provides to the UE to convey a DCN-ID.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the DCN-ID IE in a message when it wishes to provide a DCN-ID to the UE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: The user equipment that receives the DCN-ID information element from the network.

relations.description: The network includes the DCN-ID IE in a message to provide it to the UE.
The DCN-ID IE is provided by the network to the UE.
